title: Exception triage
idea: Exception triage: Actionable exceptions lead a named owner and resolution detail
audience: People who need to resolve exception within a dashboard surface.
worksWellWhen: A small urgent queue drives operations
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its resolve exception priority and explicit commitment contract: Resolving requires an authoritative update not a dismissed alert
navigation: Exception triage keeps the current resolve exception context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Actionable exceptions lead a named owner and resolution detail
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to resolve exception; a small urgent queue drives operations
composition.priority: Resolving requires an authoritative update not a dismissed alert

imagery.role: Support the actual resolve exception context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Narrow views prioritize severity owner and next action
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the exception triage structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no resolve exception content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Resolving requires an authoritative update not a dismissed alert
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized resolve exception content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Resolving requires an authoritative update not a dismissed alert
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active resolve exception context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
